visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black long-sleeved shirt and a grey skirt, stands in front of a textured light-grey wall. She looks at a white Q&A box overlay that reads '喜歡的人不喜歡自己怎麼辦' (What to do if the person you like doesn't like you back), touching her hair thoughtfully with her right hand. The lighting is bright and flat, emphasizing her facial features and the texture of the wall. (2) She begins to speak directly to the camera, her expression shifting from thoughtful to assertive. She gestures with her hands to emphasize her points while maintaining a steady eye contact with the lens. The Q&A box remains visible. (3) The Q&A box disappears, and large white subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen. She becomes more animated, nodding her head and pointing her finger as she delivers her advice. Her mouth moves rapidly in sync with the appearing text. (4) She delivers her final remarks with high energy, her eyes wide and eyebrows raised. She then abruptly turns to her left and walks out of the frame, leaving only the textured wall in view for a split second before the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide empowering and blunt relationship advice. The creator uses a common social media Q&A format to address the issue of unrequited love, encouraging viewers to maintain their self-respect and move on to the next person rather than wasting time on someone who doesn't reciprocate their feelings.
